sourceChanges.androidWebViewHost: MainActivity serves app assets from the Android assets source root, exposes the restricted Android LAN bridge, and blocks untrusted navigation/resource origins.
sourceChanges.lanUi: NativeLanScreen connects nickname, host, discovery, peer selection, ping/pong, stop, and back-to-home actions to the Kotlin bridge. This remains a LAN diagnostic prototype, not game matchmaking or synchronized play.
sourceChanges.solo: Existing React SoloGame, shared TypeScript rules, Web Worker bot, H8 first move, 2-second deadline/legal fallback, stale gameId/revision/taskId rejection, and localStorage recovery/exit deletion are reused. Runtime behavior inside Android WebView remains unverified.
sourceChanges.assetPathCorrection: MainActivity AssetManager lookup now matches apps/web/dist being registered as the Android assets source root (index.html is opened at the root, not under web/).

limitations: Do not report web tests or source inspection as Android runtime validation.
LAN screen only validates discovery/connection diagnostics; game invitation and board synchronization are not implemented in this stage.
